title: Test Strategy Output (Generate Mode)
description: Output contract for the test-strategy agent in generate mode. This structured data appears after the STRATEGY: marker.

summary.description: Brief 2-3 sentence summary of the testing strategy.

tier_assignments.description: List of tier assignments for each target file.

testing_patterns.description: Recommended testing patterns, fixtures, mocking strategies, and assertion approaches.

fixtures_required.description: List of pytest fixtures needed for testing.

assertion_patterns.description: Recommended assertion patterns for validating test outcomes.

use_cases.description: Use case definitions for integration and e2e tests.

new.description: New use cases to be implemented.

existing_applicable.description: Existing use cases that apply to the target files.

edge_cases.description: Edge cases and error scenarios that require test coverage.

test_file_mapping.description: Mapping between source files and their corresponding test files.

guidance_for_planner.description: Explicit guidance items for the test-planner agent.

TierAssignment.description: Test tier assignment for a specific source file.

coverage_target.description: Target coverage: percentage (0-100) for line_branch, count for use_case.

functions.description: List of functions in the file with their test requirements.

TestTier.description: The test tier level. unit: pure functions, utilities, isolated logic; component: service layer public APIs; integration: API endpoints with mocked external deps; e2e: full stack scenarios requiring Docker/real services.

CoverageType.description: The type of coverage metric. line_branch: per-function line and branch % (target 80%, applies to unit/component/scripts); use_case: use-case ID coverage (target 100%, applies to integration/e2e).

FunctionTestRequirement.description: Test requirements for a specific function.

priority.description: Priority level for testing this function.

notes.description: Additional notes or considerations for testing this function.

Fixture.description: A pytest fixture required for testing.

exists.description: Whether the fixture already exists in the codebase.

path.description: Path to the file containing the fixture (if it exists).

creation_notes.description: Notes on how to create the fixture (if it doesn't exist).

MockingStrategy.description: Strategy for mocking an external dependency.

target.description: The fully qualified name of the dependency to mock.

notes.description: Additional implementation notes for the mocking strategy.

AssertionPattern.description: Recommended assertion pattern for test validation.

pattern.description: Name or identifier for the assertion pattern.

description.description: Explanation of how to use this assertion pattern.

UseCase.description: A new use case to be implemented for integration/e2e testing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the use case (e.g., 'UC-USER-001').

description.description: Human-readable description of the use case.

ExistingUseCase.description: Reference to an existing use case that applies to the target files.

notes.description: Notes on how this existing use case relates to the target files.

EdgeCase.description: An edge case or error scenario requiring test coverage.

scenario.description: Description of the edge case scenario.

severity.description: Severity level of the edge case.

test_approach.description: Recommended approach for testing this edge case.

TestFileMapping.description: Mapping between a source file and its test files.

tests.description: List of test files that cover this source file.

TestFile.description: A test file and its metadata.

operation.description: The operation to perform on the test file.
